description:
Research programme ConsciTune: without answers, returns five fixed reflection questions; with answers (aim, attention, unknown, thread, certainty 0-1), stores them privately and links them to your notes. Makes no claim about consciousness. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…"}

answers.description: Your answers: to the tuning questions (tune: aim, attention, unknown, thread, certainty 0-1) or to the observer's small questions (observe: {probe_id: answer})

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

name: run_tuning_session
title: Answer the tuning questions (research)
